obligations.requirement: ResourceId and ResourceManifest entry identity is complete and collision-safe.
obligations.oracle: full 128-bit equal-prefix IDs, duplicate IDs and canonical ordering

obligations.requirement: ResourceRevision, ContentHash, length, kind and decode/layout metadata have canonical validation.
obligations.oracle: normalization, malformed hash, revision conflict, length/version mismatch matrix

obligations.requirement: Manifest binding changes affect Document digest while availability does not.
obligations.oracle: same graph+manifest, changed binding, missing/ready/corrupt availability
obligations.acceptance: digest changes only for semantic binding

obligations.requirement: Manifest mutation uses one atomic Operation family with replay/idempotency/Undo/Redo.
obligations.acceptance: one generation advance or no mutation

obligations.requirement: Snapshot/restore atomically binds manifest and digest, with explicit legacy compatibility.
obligations.oracle: round-trip, legacy capability, digest mismatch, malformed manifest, failure injection

obligations.requirement: Scene Full/Delta/Recovery and resource refresh remain equivalent.
obligations.oracle: manifest operation then full/delta/recovery and missing→ready refresh
obligations.acceptance: derived refresh without semantic generation change

terminal_blocker: AUTHORITY_CONFLICT if exact field numbers, OperationKind allocation, registry or digest bytes conflict with accepted P12/P13 input.
